title: Derived-category hom equality for exact-functor cocycle transport
statement: The derived-category morphisms underlying the exact-functor resolution cocycle identity are equal after applying the supplied comparison map.

proof.text: Extend the natural-number comparison by zero to integer-indexed complexes and use exact-functor transport on the derived-category representative of extMk.

lean.statement: theorem exactFunctor_resolution_cocycle_hom {C : Type u₁} {D : Type u₂} [Category.{v₁} C] [Category.{v₂} D] [Abelian C] [Abelian D] [HasExt.{w₁} C] [HasExt.{w₂} D] [HasDerivedCategory C] [HasDerivedCategory D] (L : C ⥤ D) [L.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits L] [PreservesFiniteColimits L] {A : C} {B : D} (f : L.obj A ⟶ B) (R : InjectiveResolution A) (I : InjectiveResolution B) (e : (L.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj R.cocomplex ⟶ I.cocomplex) (he : L.map (R.ι.f 0) ≫ e.f 0 = f ≫ I.ι.f 0) {P : C} (q : ℕ) (a : P ⟶ R.cocomplex.X q) (ha : a ≫ R.cocomplex.d q (q + 1) = 0) (hc : (L.map a ≫ e.f q) ≫ I.cocomplex.d q (q + 1) = 0) : (((R.extMk a (q + 1) rfl ha).mapExactFunctor L).comp (Abelian.Ext.mk₀ f) (add_zero q)).hom = (I.extMk (L.map a ≫ e.f q) (q + 1) rfl hc).hom
